movie.title: Beast of War
movie.overview: When their boat sinks while crossing the Timor Sea during World War II, a troop of young Australian soldiers must find a way to survive the harsh seas on a quickly shrinking raft. Hundreds of miles from anywhere, they must confront interpersonal conflicts, enemy attacks, and the advances of one very large, very hungry great white shark.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: During World War II, a stranded unit of young Australian soldiers adrift in the Timor Sea must fight for survival against enemy strikes, internal conflict, and a giant, relentless great white shark.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Set during the chaos of World War II, a troop of young Australian soldiers finds themselves stranded in the open ocean after their vessel is destroyed while crossing the Timor Sea. Left with only a flimsy, shrinking raft hundreds of miles from land, the men face extreme exposure, starvation, and growing psychological strain. Their plight escalates into terror when enemy forces launch aerial attacks and a monstrous great white shark begins stalking their small sanctuary. To survive, the soldier must overcome personal tensions and work together against both human and natural threats.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the midst of World War II, a transport boat carrying a troop of young Australian soldiers across the treacherous Timor Sea is sunk, leaving the surviving crew marooned in open water. Clinging desperately to a small, rapidly deteriorating raft, the men are stranded hundreds of miles from help with minimal supplies and no clear route to safety. As dehydration, scorching heat, and exhaustion take hold, internal friction threatens to tear the group apart from within. The situation turns fatal when enemy military forces locate the wreckage, subjecting the defenceless soldiers to terrifying strafing runs. However, an even deadlier menace lurks beneath the waves in the form of an extraordinarily large and aggressive great white shark. Drawn by blood and movement, the relentless predator begins systematically hunting the men and battering their precarious floating refuge. With their raft losing integrity and their numbers thinning, the remaining soldiers are forced to put aside their disputes and mobilize every resource at their disposal. In a desperate struggle for endurance, they make a perilous last stand against both wartime hostility and nature's most lethal killer.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Beast of War is a high-concept survival thriller that blends WWII war drama with edge-of-your-seat creature horror. The story centers on a young group of Australian soldiers who become shipwrecked in the vast, unforgiving Timor Sea. Floating on a precarious, shrinking raft hundreds of miles from land, the men must endure intense environmental hardships, incoming enemy attacks, and internal group dynamics. Their battle for life becomes exponentially more terrifying when a massive apex predator targets their raft, forcing them to fight for survival against all odds.

story_structure.climax: The remaining survivors face a desperate, high-stakes battle for survival as their raft deteriorates and the aggressive predator mounts a direct, overwhelming assault.
story_structure.conflict: Their boat sinks, stranding the soldiers on a fragile, shrinking raft hundreds of miles from safety and leaving them exposed to open waters and hostile forces.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the harrowing encounter, the physical and emotional toll of the trial is revealed as the survivors reckon with their ordeal.
story_structure.introduction: During World War II, a group of young Australian soldiers embarks on a voyage across the Timor Sea, setting up the historical backdrop, troop dynamics, and survival environment.
story_structure.risingAction: Tensions flare among the stranded soldiers over limited resources and survival strategies, while enemy threats and the relentless pursuit of a massive, predatory great white shark continuously escalate the danger.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: An Indigenous Australian soldier who leads his fellow stranded diggers through the survival ordeal with courage, selflessness, and resilience.

characters.name: Des Kelly
characters.description: A hostile, bigoted fellow soldier whose selfish behavior and antagonistic nature create constant internal conflict on the raft.

characters.name: Will
characters.description: An agreeable, loyal young soldier who forms an early bond with Leo and relies on the group to survive the perilous seas.

characters.name: Teddy
characters.description: A younger, spirited soldier who provides brief moments of levity and camaraderie amidst the horrific survival conditions.

characters.name: Commander Tetsuo Harada
characters.description: An enemy Japanese officer representing the external military threat during World War II.

characters.name: The Great White Shark
characters.description: The terrifying apex predator hunting the surviving soldiers as they drift through shark-infested waters.

relationships.description: Close friends and allies; Leo rescues Will during boot camp, establishing a bond of loyalty on the raft.
Rivals/Antagonists; Des is a hostile, racist soldier who frequently clashes with Leo over leadership and survival strategies.
Tense squadmates; conflicting personalities forced to cooperate while surviving stranded in open water.
Comrades-in-arms; fellow Australian soldiers banding together on the makeshift raft.
Mortal enemies; apex predator hunting the survivors adrift in the Timor Sea.
